roles.name: Implement role-state summary
roles.responsibility: Create the public function exclusively in src/ai_company/pilot_status.py using the fixed contract.
roles.goal: Summarize mapping values into exactly total, completed, waiting, blocked, and active integer counts without mutating input.
acceptance: Expose summarize_role_states(states: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, int] from ai_company.pilot_status.
Return exactly total, completed, waiting, blocked, and active; total equals the number of mapping entries.
Count CONTRIBUTION_READY, MERGE_READY, and DEMO_READY as completed.
Count every string starting with WAITING_ as waiting.
Count BLOCKED, NO_ELIGIBLE_AGENT, and NEEDS_RECONCILIATION as blocked.
Count all remaining string statuses as active, with each entry counted in exactly one category.
Empty input returns all five counts as zero; support Mapping inputs without modifying them.
Modify only src/ai_company/pilot_status.py; add no dependencies or unrelated behavior.

roles.name: Author independent unittest coverage
roles.responsibility: Create contract-based unittest coverage exclusively in tests/test_pilot_status.py, independently of implementation details.
roles.goal: Verify the shared public function's exact output, status classification, empty-input behavior, and nonmutation.
acceptance: Use unittest and import summarize_role_states directly from ai_company.pilot_status; do not replace or mock the function under test.
Assert exact dictionaries and integer counts, including all-zero empty input and no additional output keys.
Cover every specified completed and blocked status individually and a mixed input containing all categories.
Cover WAITING_, representative WAITING_ statuses, and an unfamiliar WAITING_ suffix.
Verify unknown strings, empty strings, lowercase variants, WAITING without the underscore, and embedded WAITING_ text are active.
Verify repeated statuses across distinct role keys count separately and category counts sum to total.
Verify an ordinary input mapping remains unchanged and a read-only Mapping input is accepted.
Keep all coverage in tests/test_pilot_status.py and derive expected results from the contract without importing implementation internals.
